title: Outcome-Linked Engagements
breadcrumb: About Us > Our Approach > Outcome-Linked Engagements
meta_description: Commercial models aligned to the metric: outcome pilots, value-linked fees, platform subscriptions.

blocks.x: Commercial models that put our economics next to the metric we move.
Traditional commercials buy effort; ours buy outcomes. Four models, selectable per program and mixable within a portfolio:

items: Outcome pilot
Fixed-fee pilot with a bonus/malus tied to the falsifiable success criterion agreed before work starts.
Value-linked program
Base fee plus share of measured value (loss reduction, throughput, unit cost) against the locked baseline.
Platform subscription
Platform usage subscription with implementation pods — predictable run cost, engineering on demand.
Co-innovation
Joint IP development with defined ownership for frontier programs (quantum, agentic) where both sides invest.

blocks.x: Every outcome-linked engagement carries a baseline pack (metrics, owners, measurement method), a quarterly value review with finance, and an annual audit against the original baseline. Measurement is agreed before work begins — never negotiated after.

items: Use an outcome pilot
when the capability is new to your estate and the capital committee wants evidence before scale.
Use value-linked fees
when the metric is unambiguous (loss rate, cycle time, unit cost) and the baseline can be locked cleanly.
Use a platform subscription
when the capability is a long-lived utility — decisioning, lakehouse, security operations.
Use co-innovation
when the frontier is genuinely unmapped and both sides accept documented negative results.

blocks.x: We do not sign outcome links on metrics the client cannot measure, on baselines that cannot be locked, or on outcomes that depend on factors outside the program's control. A failed negotiation on measurement is better than a disputed invoice.

items: A top-10 European retail bank
Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails — 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
A top-3 grocery retailer (800+ stores)
Fresh waste down 28%, OOS down 31% — day-part demand and ordering agents
A global integrated energy major
Turnaround duration down 14% — scheduling optimization at refinery scale

blocks.x: Every reference engagement above ran on this model — the gates, the measurement discipline and the commercial alignment are the same machinery in every industry. What changes is the physics.
